title: Make lexical decisions
subtitle: Let construction and co-text narrow a word’s range.
overview: A word’s possible meanings are narrowed by its grammar, nearby words, author, genre, and paragraph role. Do not choose a familiar theological gloss automatically.
A good lexical note explains why one sense fits better than alternatives in this passage.

items.grc: ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ μετὰ πάντων.
items.en: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all.
In the world you have affliction.
